    Who did Scarlett Johansson replace in Her?
    Samantha Morton
    In 2013, Johansson voiced the character Samantha, a self-aware computer operating system, in Spike Jonze's film Her, replacing Samantha Morton in the role.

    What's so special about Her film?
    Her stars Joaquin Phoenix as Theodore, a lonely man who falls in love with an AI voice, Samantha, voiced by Scarlett Johansson. The film is a poignant exploration of isolation, technology, and human connection.

    Who was the original actress in Her?
    Samantha Morton

    Description

    Theodore Twombly, an introverted writer, buys an Artificial Intelligence system to help him write. However, when he finds out about the AI's ability to learn and adapt, he falls in love with it.
    Release date: 14 February 2014 (South Africa)
    Director: Spike Jonze
    Awards: Academy Award for Writing (Original Screenplay) · See more
    Cinematography: Hoyte van Hoytema
    Running time: 2h 6m
    Budget: 23 million USD
    Distributed by: Warner Bros. Pictures
